name: Isolated thermistor feedback through gate-driver analog-to-PWM channel
function: Biases a thermistor with the gate driver's internal current source and returns temperature as an isolated duty-cycle signal, avoiding a separate isolator.

inputs.name: JB1 / RT
inputs.description: thermistor (module NTC or board sensor) referenced to the driver COM

outputs.name: APWM / THERM-P/N
outputs.description: duty-cycle signal (10-88 % at 400 kHz) to controller

operating_conditions: UCC21710 AIN biased by 200 uA (196-209 uA); RC filter for analog read-back.
interface_requirements: Prefer the driver referenced to a stable node (low side) (PRD-09301 §3.4).
Calibrate with a potentiometer in place of the NTC (PRD-06992 §4.7).
pcb_constraints: Sensor wiring stays within the driver's isolated island.
validation_notes: Bias current confirmed from the UCC21710-Q1 datasheet; temperature transfer function depends on the sensor and was not computed.
limitations: NTC temperature differs from junction temperature (PRD-06992 §4.7).
TI marks its temperature path as 'not implemented' in firmware (Table 4-1).
